subject: Plan of Record proposal — milestones, owners & timeline (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marques <elena@curavita.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Plan of Record proposal — milestones, owners & timeline (post-discovery)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and an initial Plan of Record (attached) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a realistic close window. This is meant to be a lightweight MAP we can iterate on — please mark changes and call out any missing stakeholders.

High-level summary of what we captured on the call:
- Use case: secure, low-latency inference for clinical summarization workflows (30–100 reqs/min typical).
- Success metrics: 95th-percentile latency <350ms, token cost target ~0.015 USD/token equivalent.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence, VPC deployment, procurement window 3–6 weeks.

Attached: redwood_plan_of_record_v0.1.pdf (initial draft) — includes a milestone table.

Timeline options (pick one or tell us adjustments):
A) Fast: pilot in 3 weeks, production by 2027-01-15 (aggressive; requires priority onboarding & signed T&Cs).
B) Balanced: pilot 5–6 weeks, production by 2027-01-31 (recommended).
C) Conservative: pilot 8+ weeks, production by 2027-02-28 (buffers procurement/security).

Proposed milestone table (summary):
1) Pilot kickoff — owner: Jasmine Liu (Redwood) / Curavita PO: Elena Marques — Target: week of 2026-12-15 — Dependencies: access to sample data, security questionnaire completed.
2) Security & compliance sign-off — owner: Monica Patel (Redwood) / Curavita: Priya Reddy — Target: 2026-12-22 — Dependencies: completed questionnaire, SOC2 artifact exchange.
3) Integration & validation (pilot) — owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood) / Curavita: Miguel Santos — Target: 2027-01-05 — Dependencies: VPC peering, test data slice.
4) Production cutover & SLA onboarding — owner: Jasmine Liu / Curavita Ops — Target: (depends on timeline choice).

Asks from our side:
- Confirm which timeline option you prefer (A/B/C) or provide a target close date.
- Confirm primary stakeholders we should include on the MAP (security, procurement, ops).
- Confirm availability for a 30–45 min MAP review early next week so we can lock owners and milestones.

If helpful I can also include a procurement milestone (PO / contract signature) in the next draft — I left that out intentionally to avoid assuming your internal cadence.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_plan_of_record_v0.1.pdf (17KB)

From: Elena Marques <elena@curavita.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@curavita.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@curavita.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Plan of Record proposal — milestones, owners & timeline (post-discovery)

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft. Curavita is definitely interested; the approach looks sensible. A few notes from our side: your "Balanced" timeline (B) is closest to what procurement will accept, but our legal/procurement folks will likely push for a week or two buffer. Can you give us an example PO/term timeline so procurement has something concrete?

Stakeholders to add to the MAP (please include on distribution):
- Miguel Santos — Head of Operations (will own integration/validation).
- Priya Reddy — Director, Security & Compliance (will drive security sign-off).

Preferred target close date: 2027-01-31 (we want production by end of month if possible). If you can shift the integration milestone earlier by one week (to allow internal testing before sign-off) that would help.

I've attached our security questionnaire (only high-level answers so far) — Priya will complete the remainder by next Wednesday.

We'll be available for a MAP review next Tuesday morning (UTC-8) or Wednesday afternoon. Which do you prefer?

—Elena
Elena Marques
VP Product | Curavita Health
elena@curavita.com
Attachment: security_questionnaire_Curavita.pdf (28KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Plan of Record proposal — milestones, owners & timeline (post-discovery)

Jasmine / Monica —

I can move the integration & validation milestone one week earlier as Elena asked. I'll also add a procurement milestone for PO signature with a two-week buffer before production. Monica, can you own the security artifact exchange and target sign-off date?

I'll update the draft to v0.2 and circulate to Elena for confirmation.

Thanks,
Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marques <elena@curavita.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@curavita.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@curavita.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Plan of Record proposal — milestones, owners & timeline (post-discovery)

Elena / team —

Great — thank you for the quick turn. Confirming the updates we agreed to in-line so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed stakeholders (added to MAP): Miguel Santos (Ops), Priya Reddy (Security), Elena Marques (PO).
Agreed target close date: 2027-01-28 (we discussed either 1/28 or 1/31; to give procurement a small runway we propose 1/28 as "target close" and will treat 1/31 as maximum acceptable).

Updated milestones (summary):
- Pilot kickoff — owner: Jasmine Liu / Curavita PO: Elena — Target: 2026-12-15 — Dependencies: sample data access, initial API keys.
- Security artifact exchange & sign-off — owner: Monica Patel / Curavita: Priya Reddy — Target: 2026-12-20 — Dependencies: completed questionnaire (Priya will complete by 2026-12-09).
- Integration & validation (pilot) — owner: Aditya Rao / Curavita: Miguel Santos — Target: 2026-12-29 (moved earlier by 1 week) — Dependencies: VPC peering, integration test harness.
- Procurement & PO signed — owner: Curavita Procurement — Target: 2027-01-14 — Dependencies: reviewed contract, PO submission.
- Production cutover & SLA onboarding — owner: Jasmine Liu / Curavita Ops — Target: 2027-01-28 — Dependencies: final sign-offs, billing set up.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Aditya will publish redwood_plan_of_record_v0.2.pdf to the shared Drive (linked below) and update the HubSpot deal.
- Monica will coordinate SOC2 artifacts and complete the security checklist with Priya.
- I will schedule a 30 min MAP review for Tuesday 2026-12-08 09:30 AM PST unless you prefer Wednesday; Elena, please confirm which slot works best.

Links & artifacts:
- Drive (drafts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d-plan-of-record
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/1234567
- DocuSign starter (terms): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456

If all good I will mark v0.2 as the working draft and follow up after the MAP review with a final schedule and HubSpot updates.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_plan_of_record_v0.2.pdf (18KB)
